{{Quote|Bloody beastly, this business about rebellion, ey what?|Vatoki|<ref name="RM" />}}
[[Surface Marshal]] '''Vatoki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] passenger aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when it was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]]. He was a former [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], but was exasperated by [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command's]] seemingly inadequate response to the threat posed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
